name: Resin Art Business Spreadsheet
title: Resin Art Business Spreadsheet: Resin Calculator (Part A & B), Resin Pricing Calculator, Custom Order Tracker & Profit Dashboard
etsy_title: Resin Pricing Calculator Spreadsheet, Resin Calculator, Epoxy Resin Business Cost Template, Custom Order Tracker, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Know how much resin every piece needs, what it really costs, what to charge, and when each custom order is ready.

WHAT YOU GET
• Resin calculator: pick a shape, type the size in inches or cm and get total resin, Part A and Part B (fl oz and ml), layers and cost
• Resin cost from dimensions on every product, with overpour allowance
• Pigments, mica, inclusions, hardware, packaging and mould wear (cost per pour) included
• Cost per piece, wholesale and retail prices, Etsy fees and profit
• Custom order tracker: deposits, balance due, demould dates, deadline flags
• Dashboard: sales, profit, best sellers, open orders, money still to collect

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings, Supplies & stock (100 rows), Resin Calculator, Product Pricing (40 products), Orders (200 orders), Sales log (500 rows).

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. Prices and fee rates in the examples are illustrations: type in your own. Always follow your resin maker's mixing and safety instructions.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
